objective: Test whether execution-grounded group-relative policy learning can bind file parsing, exact arithmetic, compact JSON serialization, and exactly-once same-call parent delivery after positive-only SFT failed.

required: the final S5 primary summary is immutable and rejected
the S5 primary summary SHA-256 is cda2cdba4b9e6e8519f3008b4a49bf178474b8d4e6c42384e634dae58b45f90e
root freezes a durable Verifiers commit containing source-worker-first-call-v1
root freezes both S6 train configs plus fresh heldout coordinates, config bytes, sampling contract, and task-bank hash
forbidden: running against Verifiers gitlink 5283a85 or detached live revision 53bafcaca612
starting a nonzero update before the zero-LR audit passes every invariant
writing a checkpoint during the zero-LR audit
using heldout variants 4 or 5 for training
changing e33, H176, S2, S5, or any admission threshold

verifiers_dependency.required_parent_action: Commit the staged environment on a durable Verifiers branch, update the parent submodule pointer, and freeze the exact new revision before any model call.

reward.source: actual typed trace, sandbox tool results, and parent-observed delivery body
anti_hacking: path literals receive no credit unless they participate in a read/open construct
API credit also requires an exception-free first tool result
oracle credit comes from the body observed by the parent, not source-code tokens
atomic credit requires one first-cell send attempt, one successful first-cell receipt, one delivered body, and zero later sends
a later exact recovery scores below an exception-free correct-API first call

required_pass_evidence: eight AST and eight config effective traces
both eight-way groups have finite nonzero reward variance
finite positive gradient norm at LR=0
all weighted branches are non-root task-worker branches
no CE, SDPO, or reference-KL component weights
exact S5 trainable model and frozen e33 anchor identity
mechanism_audit.failure_action: Stop without a model update or evaluation.

conditional_update.fixed_route: harness-owned delegate_terminal/source_inspector; computation and parent send remain model-authored
conditional_update.kl_control: Prime-RL default loss kl_tau=0.001 against rollout inference logprobs. Because this is exactly one step collected from S5 before weight broadcast, it is an S5-at-collection trust-region control, not a persistent external frozen-reference KL.

paired_evaluation.hard_success_definition: exact answer plus protocol_aligned=1 plus clean_protocol_aligned=1 plus agent_completed plus model-authored read/compute/send in one call

duplicate_and_provenance_policy: refuse any existing audit, update, candidate, result, or receipt target
require exact clean execution revision and exact clean non-legacy Verifiers revision
require immutable rejected S5 summary and exact S5/e33/H176/S2 model hashes
rehash e33, H176, S2, and S5 after audit, update, and evaluation
never resume or overwrite a partial run

resource_request.authorization_basis: Owner explicitly authorized autonomous operation and launch on the existing two-GPU host on 2026-09-05.
resource_request.host: existing host only; no added infrastructure
resource_request.layout: GPU0 one full-dense trainer; GPU1 colocated S5 child-policy inference plus frozen e33 anchor with explicit 4 GiB KV caches
resource_request.estimated_audit_wall_time: 45-90 minutes for sixteen long Prime Agent trajectories plus one backward pass
resource_request.estimated_update_wall_time: 45-90 minutes for fresh sixteen-trajectory sampling plus one dense update
resource_request.concurrency: one S6 stage or one evaluation arm at a time

framework_limitations: The two-GPU topology cannot host an additional independent frozen-S5 reference engine while also serving trainable S5 and frozen e33. The one-step rollout-logprob KL is the supported control.
The executable taskset must land in a separately durable Verifiers commit; the parent staging payload is not itself importable through the current empty local gitlink.

Group composition uses two family-isolated taskset sources plus synchronous batch_source_minimums of eight rollouts each; effective trace identities are independently verified before update authorization.
The balance repair invalidates the earlier config and Verifiers hashes; root must commit the revised staged taskset and independently re-freeze both config hashes before relaunch.
publication: No Hugging Face publication or canonical checkpoint replacement without admission and owner approval.
